Subdomain.description: The single label to delegate, without a dot. "team" against a parent of example.org creates team.example.org. One label only: a multi-label value needs a delegation at each level the parent does not already own, which this blueprint does not create. Constraint: one DNS label — lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen

ParentHostedZoneId.description: SSM path holding the parent zone id. Defaults to the shared zone published by shared-infra. The stack must run in the account that owns that zone — a cross-account delegation needs a role this blueprint does not assume.

ParentDomainName.description: SSM path holding the parent zone's domain name, used to build the delegated name. Must be the domain of ParentHostedZoneId; if the two disagree the NS record is created in the wrong zone and resolution fails with no stack error.

DelegationTtlSeconds.description: TTL on the NS record in the parent zone. Keep it low until the delegation is confirmed working — a wrong NS set cached for a day is a day of downtime. Raise it afterwards. CFN Type: Number, written as a string in the config (>= 60, <= 172800).
